claims: Kevin Durant is a Houston Rockets forward.
Kevin Durant is not playing in Game 1 of the 2026 NBA playoffs against the Los Angeles Lakers due to a right knee contusion/bruise.
Kevin Durant sustained the injury after bumping knees during a practice session on Wednesday.
Kevin Durant's injury is not considered long-term.
Rockets coach Ime Udoka said Durant suffered a right knee contusion in an "awkward spot" above the patella tendon during practice.
Kevin Durant was ruled out for Game 1 shortly before tip-off on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The Houston Rockets are monitoring Kevin Durant's injury day-to-day.
Kevin Durant is in his first season with Houston.
Kevin Durant led the Houston Rockets with 26.0 points per game.
